name: multi-selector
title: Multi Selector
description: A dropdown for choosing more than one option at once. Selected items collect as removable chips in the closed field, and the open panel adds search, select-all and a Clear action.
use: A form needs several choices from a long list that users will want to search or clear.
avoid: maxCount quietly hides extra picks behind a plus count unless showall is set.
a11y: Chip remove icons are bare SVGs with click handlers, so the keyboard cannot drop one pick; checkboxes have no roles. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded field with a thin grey outline holding small rounded chips, then a clear X and a chevron. Opened, it drops a narrow dark panel with a search row, a checkbox list and Clear and Close at the foot.
behaves: Clicking the field opens a searchable checklist and typing narrows the options. Ticking a row adds a chip to the field, and picks beyond the limit fold into a plus count. The X clears everything.
customise: options, defaultValue, placeholder, maxCount, showall and animation are props; chip and popover colours sit in the source.
weight: light: A button, a popover and a filtered list; nothing runs when closed.
demo: Label "Select Frameworks" with the options React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Next.js and Nuxt
issues: Nuxt is greyed out but nothing on screen explains why it cannot be chosen.
Chip remove icons are not buttons, so they are mouse-only.
polishWhy: Full-featured and consistent; tiny remove icons and an unexplained disabled row hold it back.
